en.headline: Sports dispute resolution summit set for 1 December with free registration
en.dek: The Department of Justice, Law Society and Bar Association will co-host the event to promote Hong Kong as an international centre for sports dispute resolution.
body: The Department of Justice, the Law Society of Hong Kong and the Hong Kong Bar Association will co-organise a Sports Dispute Resolution Summit on 1 December, with free registration now open on a first-come, first-served basis.

The summit aims to showcase Hong Kong’s strengths in developing into an international centre for sports dispute resolution and to deepen the city’s role as a hub for legal and dispute resolution services. It will feature experts from the Court of Arbitration for Sport, the French National Bar Council, the China Commission of Arbitration for Sport and local professional bodies.

Deputy Secretary for Justice Dr Cheung Kwok-kwan, who chairs the Advisory Committee on Sports Dispute Resolution, will speak alongside Law Society President Roden Tong, Bar Association Sports Law Committee Chairman Hew Yang-wahn and Sports Federation & Olympic Committee Vice-President Kenneth Fok.

Dr Cheung said the Department has been working with the sports and legal sectors to expand international and regional cooperation. He also indicated that a major regional sports law organisation is expected to establish its headquarters in Hong Kong later this year, with details to be announced at an appropriate time. The summit runs from 9.30 a.m. to 1 p.m.

zh.headline: 體育爭議解決高峰會十二月一日舉行 免費登記現已開放
zh.dek: 律政司、律師會及大律師公會合辦高峰會，展現香港成為國際體育爭議解決中心的優勢，名額有限先到先得。
body: 律政司、香港律師會及香港大律師公會將於十二月一日合辦體育爭議解決高峰會，現已接受免費登記，名額有限，先到先得。
高峰會旨在展現香港發展成為國際體育爭議解決中心的獨特優勢，並進一步鞏固香港作為國際法律及爭議解決服務中心的地位。活動將匯聚國際體育仲裁法庭、法國律師全國公會、中國體育仲裁委員會及本地法律專業團體的專家。
律政司副司長兼體育爭議解決諮詢委員會主席張國鈞、律師會會長湯文龍、大律師公會體育及運動法專業委員會主席丘揚萬，以及中國香港體育協會暨奧林匹克委員會副會長霍啟剛將出席並致辭。
張國鈞表示，律政司一直與體育界及法律界合作，積極拓展與國際及區域體育組織的聯繫。他預告今年內將有一家重要的區域性體育法律組織在香港設立總部，詳情將於適時公布。高峰會由上午九時半至下午一時舉行。
